notes.title: Update 3.21.0
notes.content:
[h3]Upgrade System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the requirements for mastering the LIFESTEAL, DESOLATION skills 
[*] Added the TRIPLE JUMP skill
[*] Added to get the LIFE with points
[*] Added reward for completing a level without taking damage
[*] Now points do not expire after character death
[/list]
[h3]Makeup / Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed a structure of level 6.4
[*] Changed default controls for combat moves
[*] Added a delay in the air near a wall when pressing the direction button
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the timer value was saved after the death of the character
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the widget to appear in a loop after the character died from presses
[*] Fixed a bug due to which the sound from retractable spikes was summed up
[/list]

Fixed a bug due to which the sound from retractable spikes was summed up

notes.title: Patch 3.19.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed the structure of levels 3, 5, 6 slightly
[*] Removed the fog at level 6
[*] Changed the shape of enemy energy shields
[*] Increased the size of knockback animation for Boss 5
[*] Removed the sound of taking damage from Boss 5 knockback while parrying
[*] Added Boss 5 knockback warning animation
[*] Added Boss 6 materialize warning animation
[*] Added Boss 6 melee attack warning animation
[*] The stamina bar is better synchronized with the parry and dash cooldowns

[*] Fixed animation bug for red ninjas on level 4
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Boss 6 patterns to overlap
[*] Fixed a bug that could allow to restore health after the death of a character
[*] Fixed a bug that could allow to return 2 health points for one use of LIFESTEAL
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the amplitudes of the jump and knockback were summed up
[/list]
